About these terms

These terms apply to Dukan ERP, a service operated under the TSX-MR name. TSX-MR is a project and trading name. It is not a separately incorporated company: it is operated by Abdel Kerim Taleb Ould Sidi, an individual. A business accepts them when its Owner applies for, claims a trial of, or uses a business account. Only a person able to bind the business may accept them on its behalf. Pending decision: legal_review

The service

Dukan ERP is a business tool. It is a mobile app used by a business’s Owner and staff, and a business account on this website where the Owner manages the business’s access. The customers of a business never sign in to it. It is not offered to consumers or to children.

The Owner and the staff

  • The Owner applies for the business and confirms that they may act for it. TSX-MR reviews each business and may refuse one.
  • The Owner chooses who works in the app, which stores each person is assigned to and what each person may do, and is responsible for those choices.
  • Each person keeps their password and verification codes to themselves and tells the Owner, or signs the device out, when a phone is lost.

Acceptable use

  • Use Dukan ERP only for the business’s own lawful activity, and record what really happened.
  • Enter information about customers, suppliers and staff only when the business may lawfully keep it, and tell those people what it records as the law requires. The business, not TSX-MR, decides what it records about them.
  • Do not try to reach another business’s information, to get around a permission, or to slow down or interrupt the service.
  • Do not copy, decompile or take apart the app or the service, and do not resell access to it, except where the law allows it despite this term.

Store activities

Each store is subscribed to one activity: electronics retail, money services as an agent, or both. The app shows each store only what its activity includes. Warehouses keep the electronics activity.

What Dukan ERP is not

Dukan ERP keeps the business’s own records of what its team enters. It is not a bank, not a payment or money-transfer service, and not Bankily, Sedad or any other mobile-money provider. It is not connected to any of them, does not move or hold money, does not check that a payment or an exchange took place, and holds none of the shop’s funds.

In money services, the commission is the amount the team types for each exchange. TSX-MR does not set, calculate or guarantee it.

Reports, balances and expected amounts are bookkeeping figures made from what was recorded. They are not a statement from a bank or a provider, and a difference between them and the real cash or balance is the business’s to resolve.

The free trial

  • A business that registered itself has one free trial of 7 days (168 hours), once. A business created by TSX-MR on its behalf has none, and none is added later.
  • Every contact the Owner gave must be verified first. The Owner then claims the trial on this website, signed in to the business account; it starts at that moment. The app only shows the trial’s status.
  • The trial can no longer be claimed once paid access or a grant has been approved, or the business has been refused or cancelled.
  • No payment is asked for the trial, and nothing is charged or renewed when it ends. From its exact end, the business is read-only until paid access starts.
  • Paid access approved during the trial starts when the trial ends, never during it.

Paid access, stores and seats

  • Each store has a monthly price for its activity, with staff seats included; extra seats are charged per store. The current prices are on the Dukan ERP page and confirmed in the business account. None is shown or sold in the app.
  • The business pays TSX-MR outside the app, as agreed with it, and TSX-MR confirms each payment against its reference. No payment is taken in the mobile app or on this website.
  • A store or a seat added during a paid month is charged for that month. A removal, or a change to a lower-priced activity, takes effect at the next renewal. A change to a higher-priced activity is charged for the difference when it is confirmed.
  • A store or a seat requested during the free trial may be paid during it, and starts when the trial ends, with the first paid period — charged once and never started during the trial. If no paid access has been approved by then, it waits for the first paid period.
  • A month is never charged twice, and nothing renews by itself: each period starts only when TSX-MR confirms its payment.
  • Refunds: Pending decision: refund_policy

Grace, read-only access, suspension

  • When a paid period ends without the next one confirmed, the app keeps working for 72 hours. After that the business is read-only: its records can still be read and its reports shared, but nothing new can be recorded until the next period starts.
  • TSX-MR may suspend a business, with a recorded reason. A suspended business cannot use the app until it is reinstated; its Owner can still reach the account page and delete their account.
  • A business waiting to be approved, or one that was refused, cannot use the app. Its Owner can still reach the account page and delete their account.

The business’s records

The records a business enters remain its own. TSX-MR uses them only to provide and protect the service, as the privacy policy describes.

A business can share its daily and monthly reports from the app as files. TSX-MR keeps backups to restore the service after an incident, not as a copy kept for each business: a business should keep the reports it needs.

Cancellation, termination and deletion

A person ends their own access by deleting their account in the app. When the last active Owner deletes their account, the business is closed and its access ends, as the account deletion page describes. Some records are kept, de-identified, as that page explains.

The grounds on which TSX-MR may end the service for a business, and the notice it gives, are legal wording still to be approved. Pending decision: legal_review

Intellectual property and feedback

The app, the service and this website belong to Abdel Kerim Taleb Ould Sidi. A business receives the right to use them for its own activity while its access lasts, and no other right.

Suggestions sent to TSX-MR may be used to improve Dukan ERP, without obligation to the person who sent them.

Availability and changes to the service

Dukan ERP can be unavailable during maintenance or an incident; the app keeps some actions on the phone and sends them when the connection returns. Its features may change.

What TSX-MR promises about availability, and what it is not liable for: Pending decision: liability

Disclaimers, liability and indemnity

Dukan ERP helps a business keep its records; the business remains responsible for its operations, its money, its tax and accounting obligations and the decisions it takes from its reports. Pending decision: liability

Pending decision: indemnity
